In this format, genuine inference would require at least per-feature correlation or regression against input resistance, ideally with multiple-testing correction and controls for interneuron subclass/confounding structure. Reading the CSV by eye is not a reliable substitute for that, especially because many genes are sparse and standardized values can contain isolated extreme outliers that do not represent a robust association.

If I were using only general neuroscience prior knowledge—not direct evidence from this table—the plausible candidates would be interneuron subtype markers and resting/leak conductance genes.
